scope: Second exact-arithmetic performance slice, revised after a measured rejected implementation: ancestor-prefix output domains with a sticky finite-accumulator eligibility proof.

change.method: Keep original six-term spatial reductions and link order. Restrict output rows/columns to the exact ancestor prefix only when omitted suffix columns are exactly zero. A per-call sticky eligibility flag starts true only for at most 2^16 links and remains true only while all used J, spatial inertia and weighted Coriolis operands have magnitude <=2^16. This conservatively bounds accumulated mass/Coriolis entries below2^71/2^52, safely below f32 overflow. Any unproved input makes the remainder of assembly use original dense arithmetic. All propagation, scratch, kinematic permutation, passive diagonals and both LU factorizations remain unchanged.
change.twoDimensionalPath: Original arithmetic retained; prefix path enabled only in 3D.

preSimulationArithmeticProof.fixture: Synthetic branched 25-body assemblies with 9 massless frames and 3 fixed attachments; 27-DoF free root and 21-DoF fixed root; rotated/moving states, internal kinematic joint, passive diagonals, repeated updates.
preSimulationArithmeticProof.comparison: Bitwise equality against both the original dense implementation and the previously validated zero-inertia-only implementation.
comparedBits: both LU matrices and pivot sequences
preSimulationArithmeticProof.invalidOperands: Original NaN/Inf and confirmed finite M*J-overflow cases, exact and just-above2^16 eligibility boundaries, and isolated infinite massless-frame joint velocity causing Coriolis-stage invalidation all preserve original matrix/LU/scratch bits.
preSimulationArithmeticProof.rejectedFixtureCorrection: The first overflow setup used an inverse mass at Rapier's existing zero-inverse epsilon. Its failing assertion was retained, then the fixture was corrected to confirm real overflow; no production bound or acceptance criterion changed.
preSimulationArithmeticProof.note: Standalone pinned vendored-engine lock for unit arithmetic; native and WASM workspace builds separately checked.

nativeWorkspaceParity.comparison: Exact full JSON equality, no float tolerances
nativeWorkspaceParity.standingGate: All unchanged predicates at every 800 Hz sample from 0.5 s; no failures. Full cumulative loaded slip remains <=20 mm.

limits: Still only about0.249× simulation/wall speed on this desktop/headless executor. This measured optimization does not qualify real-time use or mobile performance.
Native candidate validation is bounded to 5 physical seconds per heading; prior 33 s long-hold proof is not relabeled as directly rerun here.
Existing broader native, ballistic, recovery, mobile and real-time release gaps remain.

The full historical native inventory is not rerun for this narrow slice; its known failures are not ignored or claimed fixed. Dedicated engine tests plus exact native/browser dynamics are the new checks.

previousRejectedImplementation.causalFinding: The smaller quadform becomes cheaper, but extra inlined checks in update_mass_matrix overwhelm it. Samples do not distinguish individual inlined source lines.
